Is there evidence that this album and tour will actually materialize in 2027, or is this purely promotional content based on band announcements?
Who benefits most from early tour announcements four years in advance - promoters, ticketing platforms, or the band's management in terms of generating buzz and advance revenue?

articles.title: Lagos ranks 28th among world’s 50 most dangerous cities – Survey

articles.hausa_translation: Lagos, cibiyar kasuwancin Najeriya da inda jama'a da yawa suke, an tsara ta tsakanin gida 50 mafi haɗari a duniya a 2026, tsakanin jiya 28 a jerin laifi na duniya wanda ke haɗa tambaye game da aminci, rashin tsaroki da matsa lamba akan ma'aikatan tsaro.
